host: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D, L1d 48 KiB, L2 1 MiB, L3 32 MiB

method.samples: best-of-3 child processes, each iterations=5 warmup=2
method.base_build: GFNI + radix-eight, untiled GF16 transform workspace
method.digest_check: transmitted_parity and recovered_originals compared against base in every cell

rule.tile_bytes: target / (2 * padded_side), floored to 64 B, applied only when < aligned_prefix
rule.rationale: The padded_side key is a proxy for the live set against L3. It is only calibrated at the shard sizes swept: sides 64 and 128 fit L3 at 64 KiB but overshoot it 4-8x at 1 MiB. The calibrated entries are retained because they catch below-threshold re-sweep wins (side 256 multi-block at 64 KiB is a 33.6 MB set that still pays 1.12x-1.16x). The 64 MB threshold excludes the one measured regression, side 256 single-block at 64 KiB (0.80x-0.98x).

prediction_test.statement: side 128 at 256 KiB is a 67.1 MB live set, essentially identical to side 512 at 64 KiB (67.2 MB) which measured 1.73x, so it should gain about the same

encode.note: below threshold, correctly untiled; tiling this shape costs 0.80x-0.98x

decode.note: best cell of the campaign; padded_side 128 was excluded by both earlier tables

validation.gfni_suite: 99%, sole failure leopard2_portable_isa, pre-existing in the unmodified GFNI build
